comments: intensities are given by 1993Bo01 as per 100 neutron captures. The total |g-ray intensity feeding to g.s. gives the same result. From Budapest measured cross sections reported in LBNL and IAEA websites, normalization factor=0.5, but full details of these measurements are not available. It is difficult to make a direct comparison in view of the many differences found between the |g-ray intensities from Budapest work (see LBNL website above) and from 1993Bo01.
